ar.tool.description: Write a value to a BACnet property on a device. Returns the result as JSON or text.
ar.param.device_instance.description: BACnet device instance number (alternative to ip). Used if ip is not provided.
ar.param.value.description: Value to write. For analog types use a number string (e.g. '25.0'), for binary types use 'active' or 'inactive', for multi-state use the state number as string.
ar.param.priority.description: Optional BACnet write priority (1-16). Lower number = higher priority. Default is device-specific.
ar.err.bac0_install: BAC0 library could not be installed.
ar.err.value_required: A value is required for write operation.
ar.err.ip_or_device_required: Either ip or device_instance is required.
